newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein steady in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein steady in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were steady in late trading on Monday while crude palm oil climbed higher, traders said.
They said olein was generally quoted at 1,430-35 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, but some offers were heard at 1,425 rupiah.
The traders said crude palm oil was done at an equivalent of 1,222 rupiah/kg at a 500-tonne tender in the North Sumatran city of Medan, compared with 1,215 rupiah previously.
"Crude palm oil is getting more expensive, and this should be pushing up olein prices," one trader said. "Otherwise, we might see crude palm oil exports rising."
Data from Belawan Port showed that the MT Sappire will leave the North Sumatran port today for Jakarta with 1,400 tonnes of olein.
Data from Tanjung Priok port showed that 2,500 tonnes of olein arrived at the Jakarta port last Friday from Malaysia.
